lesson.subtitle: Lesson 11 -- Coffee Break
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 11 -- Coffee Break
lesson.grammar_point: verb to be in questions and negatives (Are you...? / I am not)

listenings.text: Good morning, everybody. Welcome to the Miami office. A quick note about today. The coffee machine is in the break room, on the fourth floor. The coffee is free, all day. The first coffee break is at ten thirty in the morning, and the second is at three thirty in the afternoon. The break room is not open after seven o'clock. If you are new here, come and say hello. We are a small team, and we are happy to meet you.

Hi, this is Paul, from the fourth floor. A small piece of advice for your first week. In this office, thirty seconds at the coffee machine is not small talk. It is work. You ask two questions, you answer two questions, and the next day the person knows your name. Are you busy? Is it hot in Brazil? How is your morning? That is all. You are not bad at English. You are new here, and that is a different thing.

extra_audio.text: It is my first day in the Miami office. A colleague asks: are you the new manager? I say: yes, I am, and I ask her name. We talk about the weather and the coffee break. Now she knows my name, and I know hers.
